name: accessibility-statement
title: Accessibility statement
description: The accessibility statement a site must publish: conformance in the heading, known gaps with workarounds and dates, how you tested and who to tell.
docs: status is written into the heading as words (fully conforms, partially conforms, does not conform), so it never relies on a badge or a colour. Pass assessed with a dateTime so the date is a time element, and keep it honest: test again after every redesign and update the date. limitations={[]} states that there are none, and leaving it out drops the section. fixBy takes a string or the dated object. Pass labels to translate the headings and the heading sentence.
